response.query: Which classroom artifacts (student work samples, digital portfolios, exit tickets, group products) best distinguish emerging from embedded 21CS across English and math?
response.answer: Student work samples and digital portfolios best distinguish emerging from embedded 21CS in English and math. Exit tickets and group products provide supplementary evidence. These artifacts show varying levels of critical thinking and collaboration.
